title: Machine Learning to Predict Digital Frustration from Clickstream Data
abstract: arXiv:2512.20438v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many businesses depend on their mobile apps and websites, so user frustration while trying to complete a task on these channels can cause lost sales and complaints. In this research, I use clickstream data from a real e-commerce site to predict whether a session is frustrated or not. Frustration is defined using certain rules based on rage bursts, back and forth navigation (U turns), cart churn, search struggle, and long wandering sessions, and applies these rules to 5.4 million raw clickstream events (304,881 sessions). From each session, I build tabular features and train standard classifier models. I also use the full event sequence to train a discriminative LSTM classifier. XGBoost reaches about 90% accuracy, ROC AUC of 0.9579, while the LSTM performs best with about 91% accuracy and a ROC AUC of 0.9705. Finally, the research shows that with only the first 20 to 30 interactions, the LSTM already predicts frustration reliably.

translated_title: 基于点击流数据的机器学习预测数字用户挫败感
translated_abstract: 许多企业依赖其移动应用和网站，因此用户在这些渠道上尝试完成任务时的挫败感可能导致销售损失和投诉。在本研究中，我使用来自真实电子商务网站的点击流数据来预测会话是否存在挫败感。挫败感通过基于愤怒爆发、来回导航（U型折返）、购物车流失、搜索困难和长时间漫游会话的特定规则来定义，并将这些规则应用于540万条原始点击流事件（304,881个会话）。我从每个会话中构建表格特征并训练标准分类器模型，同时使用完整的事件序列训练了一个判别式LSTM分类器。XGBoost达到约90%的准确率和0.9579的ROC AUC，而LSTM表现最佳，准确率约91%，ROC AUC为0.9705。最后，研究表明仅使用前20到30次交互，LSTM已经能够可靠地预测挫败感。
tldr: 本研究利用真实电商网站的点击流数据，通过LSTM和XGBoost等机器学习模型有效预测用户数字挫败感，其中LSTM表现最佳，且仅凭前20至30次交互即可实现可靠预测。
en_tdlr: This research uses clickstream data from a real e-commerce site to predict user digital frustration with machine learning models, achieving up to 91% accuracy with an LSTM classifier and showing that reliable prediction is possible with only the first 20-30 interactions.
